import gdb,struct
p=gdb.selected_inferior()
for thread in p.threads():
 thread.switch();print('THREAD',thread.num,thread.ptid)
 print('PC',hex(int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$rip'))));print('STACK_POINTER',hex(int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$rsp'))));fp=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$rbp'));seen=set()
 for i in range(40):
  if fp in seen or not fp:break
  seen.add(fp)
  try:
   prior,pc=struct.unpack('<QQ',p.read_memory(fp,16).tobytes());print('FRAME',i,hex(pc));fp=prior
  except Exception as e:print('END',str(e));break
